title: Start / resume sessions
summary: Launch --machine takes a registered Machine id (`yoke machine list`); a registered name or relay hostname resolves only when exactly one live Machine carries it. Retired Machines never match. Zero or several matches refuse machine_unresolved: several list each live candidate id with its name and last_seen_at, and a value naming a test machine adds that test machines are reached through their QA lease and points to the Machine id the install registered, listed by `yoke machine list` on the server it connected to. Native Windows launches leave shell selection to the selected harness: Claude declares Git Bash and PowerShell tools, while Codex and Cursor use the OS default. The relay removes inherited SHELL rather than supplying /bin/sh on Windows; POSIX launches select /bin/sh. Before accepting a launch or resume, the relay records the native's PID and start identity. If it cannot read that identity, the relay logs a warning with process_identity_missing, the PID and a recovery step. For Codex CLI and desktop, the relay reports startup as soon as the detached owner sends its result. The owner can continue the native turn while the relay serves other work and closes the handoff pipe after its reader stops.
